lane: Mobile app: show the server daily limit for persona chat and Tarot AI
goal: The server now refuses a 6th chat message and a 2nd delivered Tarot AI reading of the day with 429 daily_limit_reached (deployed 11/11). The app currently swallows that answer and shows its local text as if it were a reply. Tell the person plainly that today's turns are used, keep their cards and message, and align the app's own Tarot counter with the decision of 04/11 (1 Tarot AI reading per day for every account).
successCriteria: generatePersonaReply and generateTarotReading throw BackendLimitError for 429 daily_limit_reached and 503 feature_paused; other failures still fall back to local text as before; 401 is not surfaced for these two calls.
Chat shows a 'today's guide messages are used, come back tomorrow' message instead of a local reply.
Tarot shows the existing creditLimitReached message (and a resting message when paused) instead of a local reading.
The app's Premium Tarot counter is 1 per day (was 3), matching the server.
backendClient tests cover the new surfacing; existing app tests pass; tsc passes.
untouchedSurfaces: No backend change; no remaining-turns badge for chat yet (needs a read endpoint).
Council and Astrology keep their existing limit handling.

impact.entryPoint: Chat room send and Tarot draw in App.tsx.
impact.dataWrite: No new writes; the app stores nothing extra.
impact.backendContract: Reads the existing 429 daily_limit_reached and 503 feature_paused bodies.
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin change; server attempt events already show the limits.
impact.privacySafety: Crisis replies are answered by the server before the limit, so a person in crisis is never told only 'come back tomorrow'; the offline safety reply also still runs for local fallback.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; ships only with the next app build.
